profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and trades under the ticker SNAP. On its own website, the company describes itself as believing the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate, and says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The material available does not list any specific AI products from the company, and no MCP servers or lawsuits are recorded. The company's SEC EDGAR registration is under CIK 0001564408.

The held record also notes a law exposure count of 281 in California.
